description.value:
A brand blob tucks one soft lavender shape into a corner of its parent, never behind body text.

Also known as:  blob, corner blob, decoration, background shape, motif.

Which corner of the parent:  `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right`.

Takes:  `top-left` · `top-right` · `bottom-left` · `bottom-right`
Default:  `bottom-right`

`organic` (a soft egg), `mound` (a hill rising from the edge, flat side out) or `wave` (a corner wash with an S-curved edge, as the Brand Montage poster's;  flush in its corner, no overhang by default).

Takes:  `organic` · `mound` · `wave`
Default:  `organic`

Colour:  `blob` (lavender), `blob-2` (paler, grey-blue), `lilac`, `violet` (between the two), `current` (`currentColor`).

Takes:  `blob` · `blob-2` · `lilac` · `violet` · `current`
Default:  `blob`

A brand check is one line of a checklist:  a round mark, filled with a check once done, and its text.

Also known as:  check item, to-do, todo, task, habit, progress step, check mark.

**Slots:**  default

**Events:**  `ui-change`

Progress:  `done` (filled, a check), `active` (soft, pulsing) or `pending` (an empty ring, subtle text).  A checklist's `step` overrides it.

Takes:  `done` · `active` · `pending`
Default:  `pending`

Ticked:  done.  What a `checkable` check toggles;  `ui-change` first.  Alias:  `checked` (attribute and property).

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A checkbox the user ticks (click, Space, Enter):  done once ticked, the text struck through.  Inherited from a `checkable` checklist.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Text:  `sans` (14px) or `serif` (15px);  default the checklist's, else `sans`.

Takes:  `sans` · `serif`

A brand checklist shows a build's progress step by step, or a list of things to tick off, each with a round mark.

Also known as:  checklist, to-do list, todo list, task list, progress list, habit list, stepper.

**Slots:**  default

Progress:  checks before index `step` (from 0) are done, the one at `step` is active, the rest pending;  `step` at or past the last check marks them all done.  Unset:  each check's own `state`.

Takes:  number

Every check is a checkbox the user ticks (click, Space, Enter);  `step` is ignored.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Text:  `sans` (14px, 20px marks, the build progress) or `serif` (15px, 19px marks, the phone's habits).

Takes:  `sans` · `serif`
Default:  `sans`

A brand color is a square colour chip:  a label inside, an AA mark, a selected ring, a details tip;  click to copy.

Also known as:  swatch, color chip, colour chip, color swatch, color sample, color tile.

**Events:**  `ui-copy`

The colour:  `#RRGGBB`, `#RGB`, `R G B` (0-255) or `oklch(67.7% 0.047 274)`.  Anything else draws no colour.

Takes:  text

Token or step name (`brand-500`):  names the chip, and what `copy="token"` copies.

Takes:  text

Text inside the chip, bottom-left:  `hex` (`8E96B5`), `oklch` (`68 0.05 274`), `name`, or `step` (`500`, the name's last number).  In white or ink, whichever reads better.

Takes:  `none` · `hex` · `oklch` · `name` · `step`
Default:  `none`

Marks the chip `AA` when white or ink text on it passes 4.5:1.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Click copies the colour:  `hex` (bare `copy` too), `oklch`, `token` (`var(--brand-500)`) or `css` (`--brand-500: #8E96B5;`).  The chip becomes a button, named "Copy <name>".

Takes:  flag, or `hex` · `oklch` · `token` · `css`

The chosen chip:  a double ring around it.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A tip on hover and focus:  name, hex, OKLCH and contrast against white and ink.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Chip size;  `medium` is the default (3em).

Takes:  `mini` · `tiny` · `small` · `medium` · `large` · `big` · `huge` · `massive`

A brand color picker chooses a colour on an HSL square and a hue slider, or by typing HSL, hex or OKLCH;  each format copies.

Also known as:  color picker, colour picker, color chooser, hsl picker, swatch picker, eyedropper, color input.

**Slots:**  default, `header`, `actions`

**Events:**  `ui-input`, `ui-change`, `ui-copy`

The colour, `#RRGGBB` (upper-case;  anything the hex field accepts is read:  `#abc`, `142 150 181`, `hsl(250 54% 55%)`, `oklch(67.7% 0.047 274)`).  Reflects;  default `#8E96B5`.  The attribute's FIRST value is the form's reset value.

Takes:  text

Form field name:  the form gets `value`.

Takes:  text

Name of the picker for screen readers (its group);  default:  what names it, else `Colour`.

Takes:  text

Faded;  nothing in it can be used (copying neither).

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A brand color range is a 17-step ladder of shades made from one base colour, the base colour's step ringed.

Also known as:  color scale, colour scale, color ramp, shades, tints and shades, color ladder, palette row.

**Events:**  `ui-change`

The base colour (`#8E96B5`, `R G B`, `oklch(...)`).  It lands EXACTLY on its step;  none:  no ladder.

Takes:  text

The step the base colour sits at;  `auto`:  the step nearest its lightness.

Takes:  `auto` · `25` · `50` · `75` · `100` · `150` · `200` · `300` · `400` · `500` · `600` · `700` · `800` · `850` · `900` · `925` · `950` · `975`
Default:  `auto`

How colourful the steps are, in percent of the base colour's (the Chooser's Vibrancy):  0 is grey.

Takes:  number
Default:  `100`

Degrees the hue drifts toward the dark end:  the darker steps lean toward a neighbouring hue.

Takes:  number
Default:  `0`

Token prefix:  chips are named `<name>-25` ... `<name>-975`, and `css()` writes those tokens.  None:  `color`.

Takes:  text

Text inside every chip, as `<ui-brand-color label>`.

Takes:  `none` · `hex` · `oklch` · `name` · `step`
Default:  `none`

Marks `AA` on the steps text reads clearly on.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A click on a chip copies it, as `<ui-brand-color copy>`.

Takes:  flag, or `hex` · `oklch` · `token` · `css`

Each chip's details tip, on hover and focus.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Step numbers under the chips:  `shown`, or `none` (no numbers, nor their row:  a page numbering many ladders once, in a header row).

Takes:  `shown` · `none`
Default:  `shown`

A small strip of 17 dots instead of chips (the Chooser's folded Variants header).

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A brand color set lays out colour chips in a row or a grid;  `selectable` makes it a radio group to pick one.

Also known as:  swatches, swatch picker, color picker, palette, color presets, color choices.

**Slots:**  default

**Events:**  `ui-change`

The chosen chip:  its `name`, else its colour.  Setting it selects the matching chip;  choosing a chip sets it.

Takes:  text

Chips per row:  a grid of equal cells, each chip filling its cell.  None:  one row, chips shrinking to fit.

Takes:  number

A radio group:  click, Enter or Space chooses a chip, the arrow keys move and choose, Home / End go to the ends.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A brand composer is the box where you describe an app in plain words and cast it:  a serif text box, tool chips, a keyboard hint and a round Cast button.

Also known as:  composer, prompt box, prompt input, chat input, message box, spell box, command box.

**Slots:**  `eyebrow`, `tools`

**Events:**  `ui-input`, `ui-change`, `ui-cast`

The text.  Attribute:  the starting (and reset) value;  property:  the live value, as `<ui-textarea>`'s.

Takes:  text

Form field name:  the form gets `value`.

Takes:  text

Hint shown while empty;  default `Describe what you want to build…`, `placeholder=""` none.

Takes:  text

Lines tall when empty;  the box grows as you write.

Takes:  number
Default:  `3`

Name of the text box for screen readers;  default:  what names the host (`aria-label`, `<label for>`), else `eyebrow`, else `Your spell`.

Takes:  text

Small mono caps line above the text box (`Try a spell`);  or `slot="eyebrow"`.

Takes:  text

Keyboard hint beside the tools;  default `⌘↵ to cast` (`Ctrl+↵ to cast` off Apple devices), `hint=""` none.

Takes:  text

`medium` (the app's Build box:  17px text, small shadow) or `large` (the marketing hero's:  19px text, larger shadow and radius).

Takes:  `medium` · `large`
Default:  `medium`

Busy:  the Cast button spins and casting is paused (the text stays editable).  The page sets it while it builds, and clears it.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Faded;  can't be typed in or cast, left out of the form.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A brand field wraps one control with its label, a value readout, action buttons, an info tip, help and errors.

Also known as:  property, inspector row, form field, labelled control, fieldset row.

**Slots:**  default, `label`, `actions`, `value`, `info`, `help`

Label text;  `slot="label"` is the rich version.  Names the control for screen readers.

Takes:  text

Readout at the end of the label row (`100%`, `+8°`);  or `slot="value"`.

Takes:  text

Tip shown from an info icon at the end of the label row;  `slot="info"` is the rich version.

Takes:  text

Help text under the control;  or `slot="help"`.

Takes:  text

Error text under the control (and the `error` state);  `<ui-form>` sets its own through `showErrors()`.

Takes:  text

Field state:  tints its label, help and error text.  An error shows `error` on top.

Takes:  `error` · `info` · `success` · `warning`

Label row beside the control, not above it.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Marks the label with an asterisk.

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Dimmed and not usable (`inert`).

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

A brand flourish draws generated page art (swoops, blobs, curls, sparkles) behind its parent's content.

Also known as:  flourish, decoration, swoosh, blob, background art, squiggle.

Which flourish:  `swoop`, `blobs`, `edge-curls`, `sparkle-trail`, `rising-wave`.

Takes:  `swoop` · `blobs` · `edge-curls` · `sparkle-trail` · `rising-wave`
Default:  `swoop`

Which one of the variant:  another seed, another shape.

Takes:  number
Default:  `7`

Line colour;  default the theme's flourish line (lilac).

Takes:  text

Shape colour;  default the theme's blob (lavender).

Takes:  text

Second shape colour;  default the theme's second blob.

Takes:  text

Line weight, px.

Takes:  number
Default:  `1.6`

The Spell logo:  the hat mark, or the mark with the wordmark (and tagline), outlined, in one colour.

Also known as:  logo, lockup, wordmark, brand mark, hat mark.

Which:  `mark` (the hat), `lockup` (hat + Spell), `tagline` (+ All magic, no fuss.), `app` (hat + Spell App).

Takes:  `mark` · `lockup` · `tagline` · `app`
Default:  `mark`

Colour:  `ink` (the theme's strongest text), `purple`, `lilac`, `aubergine`, `white`, `current` (`currentColor`).

Takes:  `ink` · `purple` · `lilac` · `aubergine` · `white` · `current`
Default:  `ink`

Accessible name;  default `Spell` (`Spell App`).  `""`:  decorative, hidden from screen readers.

Takes:  text

A brand phone frames live app content as a phone:  a status bar on top, the app below.

Also known as:  phone frame, device frame, phone mockup, device mockup, app preview, mobile preview.

**Slots:**  default

The status bar's clock:  any text, default `9:41`.

Takes:  text
Default:  `9:41`

Fades the phone (to 45%) while its app is being built, and marks it busy (`aria-busy`).

Takes:  flag (present / absent)

Accessible name of the region around the app;  default `App preview`.  `""`:  no region, just a frame.

Takes:  text
